name: Conan Lee
biography: Conan Lee Yuen-Ba (李元霸) is a film actor and martial artist born in Hong Kong in 1959. His family moved to Queens, New York, where he grew up as Lloyd Hutchinson. After high school, he moved to California to be an actor. There, Hong Kong actor Fung Yi introduced him to a few producers including Ng See-Yuen (吳思遠). In 1982, he starred in Ninja in the Dragon's Den (龍之忍者).
birthplace: Hong Kong, British Crown Colony [now China]
